posts.title: Attending the Metallica Concert in Budapest
posts.description: I had the privilege to attend the Metallica 2-day concert in Budapest at the Puskás Arena. The concert had Gojira, Pantera, Knocked Loose and Avatar (Swedish) as supporting bands. Experiencing this concert is a dream come true experience for me. I have been listening to Metallica since I was 14yo. I feel very proud to have seen them live 🤘. posts.title: Negatives of coding with AI
posts.description: I have been using Claude code for several months now. I am quite impressed by its abilities. Although I have a growing sense that using LLMs for code generation is a double edged sword which can easily swing in the wrong direction.
